Market today: Tech had an oversold bounce Monday, but earnings this week are the real test. Your concentrated tech/chip book, especially on margin, means these moves hit hard.

Your holdings: SMCI (-26.85%) and SOXL (-56.11%) are deep in the red and flagged for attention. MU (-30.63%) and SPAL (-35.9%) are also significant losers.

Watch: The chip sector's ability to sustain this bounce after a bruising selloff.

Bottom line: Earnings this week are critical to see if this bounce has legs.
plays: Consider trimming SMCI if it fails to hold current levels, given the significant drawdown.
No new buys today - hold and watch.
